name: yxj-paper-os
description: Academic paper positioning, whole-paper architecture, drafting and revision through a focused, evidence-aware skill.

interface.shortDescription: Reader-first academic paper design and revision.
interface.longDescription: YXJ Paper OS helps position research, construct whole-paper architecture, develop a manuscript, and reread, revise and prepare the requested deliverable. It retains four explicit manuscript prohibitions, uses host-provided yxj-practice when invoked proactively, and selects quantitative analysis for the task while preserving adopted project requirements.
capabilities: Scientific positioning and supported contribution choices
Whole-paper architecture, section hierarchy and cross-section synthesis
Manuscript drafting, substantive revision and submission preparation
Four explicit manuscript prohibitions with scientific conditions preserved
Intent-aware proactive use with host-provided yxj-practice
Task-selected language statistics and venue comparison
Figure and evidence roles with reusable writing examples
defaultPrompt: Help me design the whole-paper structure around this research question and evidence.
Revise this manuscript to develop its main argument and prepare the requested deliverable.
Analyze this paper with the language statistics and reference scope specified by the project.
